x: We made a good start when Frank Craft won the 100 yards match event, and then Ian Badiali was first home in the 880, while Bill Lucas finished third in the one mile, after being content to amble in behind Parlett, only to get beaten up the straight for second place.
The 100 yards saw a new title-holder in Frank Craft, who has now gone to Australia, worse luck, and he beat " Ginger " Holtum, with Alan Sexton in third place.

George Clay has received an interesting letter from Frank Craft, our 100 yards champion, who is now resident in Queensland, Australia. He writes to say that he has just failed to qualify for the Olympic selection although he has had a very successful season.
